run_flask_server: run the flask app on port 5010 to display image comparison in a browser
run_process_csv: run process_csv to load a CSV and rearrange baseline and ours image columns
run_rearrange_images: run rearrange_images on a DataFrame row to swap baseline and ours image paths
review_display_images: review the display_images Flask route that renders the HTML template with image data
refactor_html_template: refactor the html_template Jinja2 string to customize the image comparison table layout
